description: CLA-02 /chat request body. Each case's input is a model, conversation history (oldest first), the labelled screenshots in capture order and the transcript T; the system prompt is always shared/prompts/companion-voice-response.txt. Image bytes are stubbed as short hex sequences carrying a PNG (89 50 4E 47) or JPEG (FF D8 FF) magic, so expected.messages pins the exact base64. expected.mediaTypes is the sniffed media_type per input image (ClaudeAPI.swift:51-62: PNG when the first four bytes are 89 50 4E 47, otherwise JPEG). Body shape: ClaudeAPI.swift:112-148.

cases.note: The tracer shape: one monitor, no prior exchanges, so messages is the single image-bearing user turn.
